Definition: tender (literally or figuratively); by implication, weak
BiblicalUsage: 1) tender, soft, delicate, weak; 1a) tender, delicate (of flesh); 1b) weak of heart, timid; 1c) soft (of words); 1c1) gentle words (subst)
